content.comment_body: Good morning, last night I installed my [product_name] [article_no] at the customer's location to record two temperatures. I disconnected the power and brought the device to the office to download the data. When accessing the [product_name], it requested the password, and I found the recorded data inside. Why did this happen?
I simply turned the [product_name] off and on, then downloaded the data.
Has your issue been resolved or is it still ongoing?
If I power the device off and on, shouldn't I lose the stored data?
I'm sorry, but I don't fully understand what your issue is. Can you clarify the problem with the data log?

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered unexpected behavior with data retention on a [product_name] after power cycling the device. The user thought the temperature log data would be lost after disconnecting and reconnecting power, but found the data persisted, leading to confusion about how the device manages stored data. There is uncertainty on how data logging and protection works, and the conversation highlights a lack of clarity in communication.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected that powering off and then on the [product_name] would result in loss of recorded data.
